nodes.label: Phase 4 Naming Debt (Incomplete Renames and Misleading Names)
nodes.rationale: Key issues: (1) ObservationSchema.tags not renamed alongside ActionSchema.required_capabilities — half-complete rename causes contributor confusion. (2) ActionKind implies behavioral constraints that don't exist — advisory LLM label only. (3) state_mutations is stringly-typed with implicit inventory/ext conventions. (4) role.observations is documentation stored as structure — not validated or enforced. (5) AgentOwnershipMode misleads — describes lifecycle control not data ownership.
